assumption: every active opposite-pair chart is a minimum 1|4 cut of K5
theorem: Under the local-minimum-cut assumption, every nonzero q=4 apartment-code word containing the fixed apartment is one of the eight chamber stars through that apartment.
consequence: Any hypothetical non-chamber weight-256 word must contain at least one heavier 2|3 chart.
weight256_parameterization: If A2=2t counts 2|3 charts, then A1=256-3t and the total active-chart count is 256-t.
boundary: This is a conditional rigidity theorem, not a complete q=4 minimum-shell classification.
